---
title: "Blog"
subtitle: "News and ideas from the Dutch Development Economics Network and its members"
title-block-banner: "#0D2757"
title-block-banner-color: body
page-layout: full
# every post is a folder here with an index.qmd; its categories are its tags
listing:
  contents: "*/index.qmd"
  type: default
  sort: "date desc"
  fields: [image, date, title, description, author, reading-time, categories]
  date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"
  image-placeholder: ../../images/social-card.png
  categories: numbered
  sort-ui: [date, title]
  filter-ui: true
  page-size: 10
  feed: true
language:
  listing-page-field-categories: "Tags"
  listing-page-category-all: "All posts"
  listing-page-no-matches: "No posts match your search"
format:
  html:
    grid:
      sidebar-width: 250px
      body-width: 1000px
      margin-width: 200px
    anchor-sections: false
---
